records.reason: dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 headless prints only the final assistant text, so the adapter claims text transcript and no event stream. A --patch overlay on agent-default-model produced a request header with provider deepseek-official and model deepseek-v4-pro. The packaged Agent Neo Dev 3 build detected dsh_cli as installed/ready/executable and completed one read-only turn end to end (turn_start → message_delta → message_snapshot → turn_end → agent_complete) on deepseek-v4-flash; the same turn attempted a real file write, which the read-only sandbox refused and whose escalation failed closed with no approval channel, leaving the working directory empty.
